title: Kagamine Len — Happy Anniversary! 2023〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank you all for coming to celebrate our anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm all warmed up and ready! How about you guys?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hahaha, I'll take that as a yes! Alright, how about our fans joining us from home?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! Look at that flood of messages! They're too fast for me to read them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I guess they're just as excited to get started!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I also can't wait to make this memorable day with you all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, me too. I already know it's going to be wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, I think it's about time for Len's part. Take it away!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Leave it to me!
Ahem...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank you all for waiting! My part of the Kagamine Rin and Kagamine Len Special Anniversary Show starts...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's time for a singing showdown! Which team will win the most cheers during the chorus? Let the battle commence!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, they're neck and neck! This is going to be a close one!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which side are you on? If you're at the venue, show us with your glow sticks! If you're watching the stream, comment the team name of who you think should be victor!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What a showdown! I think it's time for a well-deserved breather...
Wait a minute...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What happened to the candles?! We brought them especially for this occasion, too...

rows.Speaker: Klepto KYTO
rows.Line: Muahahaha! It is I, Klepto KYTO! Stealer of the light and riddle aficionado!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: S-Say what now?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Those belong to us! Now give them back!

rows.Speaker: Klepto KYTO
rows.Line: If you wish to see your precious candles again, you must follow the clues and locate them yourself!

rows.Speaker: Klepto KYTO
rows.Line: Half of them are within this venue, while the other half can be found on the livestream site.

rows.Speaker: Klepto KYTO
rows.Line: Now if you excuse me, I'll be off enjoying this spectacle from the shadows. Toodle-oo!

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line:
Come on, come on...
Let's see... Cloak off, check. Scarf on, check... Oh! I need to bring the envelope with the clues!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Klepto KYTO? You seem to have left your mic on!

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: Huh? Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That little mystery sure was fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know we could have done something simpler instead, but I really wanted to get the audience involved!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank you everyone for helping out! If it wasn't for our audience, we wouldn't have managed to safely retrieve every last candle!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It was a pleasure to encounter that clumsy candle crook, too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't you think, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: C-Candle crook? I don't know what you're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, it's time to wrap things up with a few personal messages from us!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Len! That candle thief segment you came up with was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As usual, you went out of your way to put on a show for everyone, even though we were supposed to be the ones celebrating you. You were amazing today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, the singing showdown and the mystery segment were amazing! I was kinda anxious since it was completely different from our usual shows, but...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Tee hee, we totally didn't need to worry! Let's keep up the creativity for another year! Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Len. You've always got some amazingly fun idea up your sleeve.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There are times I'm convinced you've taken it too far, but the looks on everyone's faces soon prove me wrong. Hehe, I can't wait to see what else you have in store for us next.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Len, happy anniversary! You're always coming up with ways to put a smile on everyone's face. Take today, for example!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's one of the many things I like about you. Next time you think of something, don't forget to invite me. I'd love to help out!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Len, firstly, congratulations on delivering a fantastic performance. I'm glad you and Rin had a good time, despite a few hiccups along the way...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Today has definitely given me plenty of inspiration for my anniversary show! I hope you can give me a few pointers when it comes around. Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ready everyone? All together now!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe, thanks everyone!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I may have a lot of fun ideas, but most of them would be useless if I were alone. It's the shared experience that makes them so fun.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So thank you everyone, for always jumping on board with my ideas!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Next time my brain hatches an idea, I'll be sure to let you all know so we can have even more fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh yes, please do!
